purpose: Curated SimReady packages to ingest for the D-34 digital twin / gate G-13 (docs/ASSETS.md 4). This is an explicit allow-list: ops/fetch_simready.py --fetch refuses any package not listed here.

include: one 256x256 thumbnail PNG and up to two <=1.5 MB texture PNGs per package
exclude: large albedo/normal texture maps (many are 10-40 MB each; full package download would exceed the budget)
download_policy.note: All package ids below were confirmed to exist in the live Hugging Face dataset tree on 2026-11-19. 'nearest' means no exact asset for the task class exists in nvidia/simready-assets; the stand-in is named explicitly and must not be reported as an exact match.

repos.license_note: Per docs/ASSETS.md (S-35); per-package licence verified from com.nvidia.simready.packaging.json during --catalog.
